audit.why: 48.47% Emerald+ over 163 games matches the page's shape: Aurora owns the early lane, Master Yi owns it from his first item.
Aurora 1-3, even at 4-5 as Wuju Style points land, Master Yi from first item. That is the right curve for a scaling on-hit duellist against a poke mage.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is absent: Highlander makes Master Yi IMMUNE TO ALL SLOWING EFFECTS. That switches off The Weirding's slow and Between Worlds' slow — the entire basis of Aurora's kite — for the duration. The page says to fight inside your R zone against exactly the ability that ignores it.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'making him immune to all slowing effects'. Aurora's E and R are both slows (champ-data/_kits/aurora.json).
audit.corrected: While Highlander is up your slows do nothing to him — the rift zones his team, not him. Fight him before he presses it or after it ends, and use the leap for distance rather than the slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Alpha Strike makes him untargetable while it travels, so burst spent as he jumps is wasted. It is also a 20s cooldown at rank 1 — his longest non-ultimate window and his only gap-closer besides raw movement speed.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed... while simultaneously becoming untargetable.' Cooldown 20/19.5/19/18.5/18. Confirmed by champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json.
audit.corrected: Do not spend the combo into an incoming Alpha Strike — he cannot be hit until he arrives. Once it is down he is 20 seconds from another gap-close.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Alpha Strike 20s at rank 1, Meditate 10s, Wuju Style 14s, Highlander 85s flat.
audit.corrected: Highlander is 85s flat — shorter than your 140s Between Worlds at rank 1, so you never win an ult-for-ult trade with him.

notes: champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json asserts 'Master Yi's Meditate (W) is a channel — your Between Worlds (R) cancels it outright.' Meditate is genuinely a channel, but nothing in Riot's text gives Between Worlds an interrupt: it damages, slows, and creates a crossable zone. I did NOT write the cancel claim anywhere. If Aurora's R shockwave does in fact displace or interrupt, that is worth confirming and would be a real addition here and in the Pantheon and Poppy pages, which carry the same generated claim. Separately: there is no CHAMP_FULL.aurora['masteryi'] entry at all — 71 keys exist in champ-data/aurora.full.js and masteryi is not among them, so every edit here is content-layer only and the full layer for this matchup is simply absent.
